questions.q: What are the three types of Lightning page?
options: Standard, Custom, and Hybrid pages
Home Page, Record Page, and App Page
List View, Detail View, and Edit View
Classic Page, Lightning Page, and Mobile Page
questions.explain: The lesson identifies Home Page (an app's landing tab), Record Page (a specific object's records), and App Page (a freestanding page) as the three types.

questions.q: What do you drag components from, onto the canvas, when building a Lightning page?
options: A component palette shown on the left side of the Lightning App Builder
The Object Manager's field list
The App Launcher
A separate Apex development tool
questions.explain: The Lightning App Builder shows a component palette on the left (List View, Report Chart, Tabs, Rich Text, and more) that you drag onto the live canvas.

questions.q: What does the Lightning App Builder's own Setup list page show for each page?
options: Only the page's name, with no other detail
Label, Name, Type, and who created and last modified it, with Edit/Clone/Del actions
A list of every Apex trigger associated with the page
Only pages that are currently activated and assigned
questions.explain: The Setup list page shows Label, Name, Type (Record Page, Home Page, etc.), Created By, and Last Modified By, with Edit, Clone, and Del actions.

questions.q: Why isn't a Lightning page visible to anyone just because it was built and saved?
options: Because it also has to be activated and assigned at one of three levels before it displays
Because Lightning pages require an Apex deployment to go live
Because only System Administrators can ever view a Lightning page
Because it must first be converted to a page layout
questions.explain: The lesson explains that building a page doesn't automatically show it to anyone — it has to be activated and assigned at the org default, app default, or app/record type/profile level.

questions.q: Among Org Default, App Default, and App-Record Type-Profile assignment levels, which one wins when more than one applies to the same user?
options: Org Default always wins regardless of other assignments
Whichever was created first wins
App Default always overrides App, Record Type, and Profile
The most specific level — App, Record Type, and Profile — overrides the other two
questions.explain: The resolution order is: Org Default is shown unless overridden by App Default, which is itself overridden by the more specific App, Record Type, and Profile assignment.
